# Documentation conventions

## Rules
- Layout: `docs/{adr,cli,code-graph,core,guide,mcp,schemas,sdk,skills}/`. Else only root `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Markdown only.
- `docs/guide/`: user-facing SpecD use only. Every file frontmatter: `title`, `description`, integer `sidebar_position`; missing fails validation. Internal/package material goes package refs (`docs/{skills,core,code-graph,sdk,schemas}/`).
- Guide opens `what-is-specd.md` (first sidebar/public entry): purpose, actions, Code Graph, links install/quickstart/philosophy/index/code graph. Index stays topic map and links it.
- Guides match core config/workflow/schema behavior. Document Code Graph, `specd project update` plugin-asset orchestration, config cascade. `configuration.md` + `configuration-examples.md` agree: `specd.yaml` + `specd.*.yaml` + `specd.local.yaml`.
- Document archive variables exactly: `{{year}}`, `{{month}}`, `{{day}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.archivedName}}`; no uninstalled engine. Hooks/schema templates substitute `run:`, `instruction:`, `template`, `deltaInstruction`, rules. Developer `run:` verbatim; translate only host-shell-incompatible quotes, never call substitution shell escaping. Non-Windows hook shell: absolute `SHELL`, else `/bin/sh`.
- Document workspace `metadataPath`, graph discovery, `prefix` segments, reserved `root`; project update only required after manual `plugins.agents` edits or package upgrade, general config runtime-resolved.
- `docs/guide/skills.md`: skills user↔CLI, slash command → agent steps → CLI; catalog `/specd`, `/specd-new`, `/specd-design`, `/specd-implement`, `/specd-verify`, `/specd-archive`, `/specd-compliance`, `/specd-fasttrack`; uses `--format toon`, `specd guide`; source `.agents/skills/`.
- Code Graph docs (`code-graph.md`, `index.md`, `philosophy.md`, `skills.md`, `cli.md`) cover `--documents`, `--files`, `--spec <id>`, `--export <name> --from <surface>`, aggregate multi-file impact, directions/depth, hotspots, coverage diagnostics.
- ADRs: MADR structure verbatim, mandatory frontmatter `status`, `date`, `decision-makers`, `consulted`, `informed`; mandatory Context, Decision Outcome/`### Confirmation`, More Information/`### Spec` linked constraints. Drivers/options/pros-cons optional if valueless. Sequential never-reused `NNNN-kebab-title.md` from `0001`; retained number when deprecated/superseded. ADR for multi-package, future-constraining, or non-obvious alternative choice; not natural implementation detail.
- `docs/cli/`: each `specd` command dedicated doc: purpose, flags, examples, exit codes; command output/caching/machine contracts. `index.md` complete family directory. User recipes in `docs/guide/cli.md`. Each `docs/cli/<command>.md` listed matching `apps/public-web/sidebars.ts` category.
- `docs/mcp/`: every `@specd/mcp` tool/resource has input schema, output schema, example.
- `docs/{core,code-graph}/`: package refs, not host import guides. Prominent callout: hosts start `docs/sdk/`, import `@specd/sdk`. `@specd/core` examples labeled plugin/core-only; optional sdk re-export footnote cannot imply host choice. Core-only `plugin-*`/`skills` may use core.
- `docs/sdk/` only Docusaurus integrator entry, SDK before package refs. Hosts (cli/mcp/API/IPC) import only `@specd/sdk`: no parallel core/code-graph deps or mixed imports. Cover `.`, `./ports`, `./extensions`, `openSpecdHost`, `createSdkContext`, helpers, `createKernel` + `kernel.*.execute()`, standalone `createX`/`create*Repository`. Website API generation/landing treat SDK as host surface. Remove `docs/core/sdk.md` and all refs; do not alter `docs/core/index.md` merely for removal.
- SDK collection roots: `docs/sdk/`, `docs/core/`, `docs/code-graph/`, `docs/skills/`, `docs/schemas/`; handwritten docs require guide-equivalent frontmatter/failing validation. Exclude `docs/cli/`, `docs/public-web/`.
- SDK discoverability: `specd guide` catalog structured `specd guide-sdk` in every format; `docs/guide/index.md` link; guide CLI recipe; `docs/cli/guide-sdk.md` documents search and guide vs guide-sdk collections; CLI index + sidebar expose it.
- JSDoc all functions/methods/classes/type aliases/interfaces: description, each `@param`, non-void/non-ctor `@returns`, each `@throws`.
- Update `docs/` with `@specd/core` public composition changes: canonical `createX(deps)`, convenience `createX(config, options?)`, standalone vs `createKernel(...)`/`createKernelBuilder()`, config bootstrap `CompositionResolver`.
- Same change updates every doc of removed/renamed template token, cascade rule, or listing/summary input/output/dependency contract. Search all docs; likely `docs/{guide,schemas,adr,core,cli}/` files listed by source.

## Constraints
- Specs with ADR provenance use `## ADRs`; omit when none. List producing ADRs only, never dependencies. Specs depend only on specs; capture enforceable ADR decision in spec first.
- Token/contract changes documentation-affecting under `docs/config/`, `docs/guide/`, `docs/schemas/`, `docs/adr/`, `docs/core/`, `docs/cli/` as applicable.
